title: Trial at the Marble Edge
description: Marble Law, Iron Oath: Trial at the Marble Edge unfolds across floating marble arena edge connected to storm bridge anchors, with broken terraces and bronze judgment rails, pushing the 5-Titan Asgardian squad to convert endurance into decisive counterpressure.
lore: Trial at the Marble Edge advances the Storm-Oath Covenant arc: the Gate tries to harvest Asgardian vows, while Valhalla law insists courage must remain chosen responsibility.
terrain: floating marble arena edge connected to storm bridge anchors, with broken terraces and bronze judgment rails

objectives.primary: Win the trial objective without abandoning Asgardian formation law.
optional: Keep at least four Titans standing
Trigger at least two Oathbound counterattacks

specialRules: Trial Terms: optional objectives change rewards but never overwrite faction identity.
Oathbound: surviving damage strengthens the next committed strike.
victoryConditions: Win the trial objective without abandoning Asgardian formation law.

stars.one: Primary completed under severe casualty or turn pressure

squadDesignNotes: Balanced for the standard 5-Titan squad; special future modes may override team size explicitly.
